summary.title: Summary
paragraphs: Frontend engineer with {{OVERALL_EXPERIENCE_YEARS}} years of experience building complex, data-heavy web applications in React and TypeScript. Since 2022 on the frontend of a crypto exchange: real-time order books and charts over WebSockets, high-frequency state, arbitrary-precision trading math. Before that, frontend platform work for Ukraine's largest job board: architecture migration, CI speed, Core Web Vitals.

Comfortable beyond the frontend: Node.js, GraphQL and serverless AWS (certified). Outside XBO: co-founded ELI, an AI tutor with paying subscribers; built Mrrlin, a workspace for coding agents, and the agent harness that runs both products' email and support operations. Looking for a hands-on Senior or Staff frontend IC role: architecture, performance and shipping.

entries.name: Senior Frontend Engineer · XBO.com, crypto exchange
entries.descr: Architected and built the frontend of an award-winning crypto exchange (Best Digital Assets Exchange 2024, Best Crypto Processing Solution 2025): spot, futures, CFDs and a loyalty program in 10+ languages.
bullets: Real-time data layer: SignalR/WebSockets with sub-second updates for order books, charts, price tickers and portfolio positions.
State under load: reactive state management with RxJS for high-frequency streams without UI degradation.
Financial precision: arbitrary-precision arithmetic across trading calculations; advanced TypeScript patterns for type-safe financial computations.
Order placement: complex reactive forms with real-time validation.

AI-driven delivery: since mid-2026 my work here runs through an agent harness I built around the team's Azure DevOps flow: agents turn user stories into implementation-ready specs, coding agents implement in isolated git worktrees, a multi-model consensus gate reviews the design and every PR, browser QA agents verify acceptance criteria with screenshot reports, and a design QA agent checks the result against Figma.
entries.stack: React, Redux, TypeScript, SignalR, RxJS, Claude Code, Codex, MCP

entries.name: Frontend Engineer → Frontend Tech Lead · robota.ua
entries.descr: Ukraine's largest job board: 6.5M+ resumes, 100K+ active listings, 35K+ companies. Grew from mid-level engineer to tech lead of the frontend platform.
bullets: Architecture: moved a 20-year-old .NET/jQuery monolith to Angular + GraphQL (Apollo) services with a Tailwind component design system; built the mobile SPA from scratch.
CI/CD: migrated TeamCity to GitHub Actions with dynamic agents, incremental builds and caching: build time from ~40 to ~20 min, no more CI queues.
Web Vitals: Cloudflare optimizations, static caching and RxAngular to cut zone.js overhead; critical pages moved from red to green.
Reliability: TypeScript strict mode, SonarQube in PRs, wider ESLint coverage, Sentry with automatic owner assignment; fewer production incidents.
Developer experience: interactive CLI tools for routine work (library generation, GraphQL schema regeneration).
Beyond frontend: serverless GEOHASH-based ETA service for public transport on GCP (Cloud Functions + Datastore) that reduced Google Maps API costs.

entries.name: Co-Founder & Engineer · ELI, AI language tutor

entries.name: Creator · Agent operations harness (Hermes Agent + Outlab)
entries.descr: Built alone: an always-on Hermes Agent runs ELI's and Mrrlin's email and support operations through Outlab, a TypeScript service (Hono, SQLite), with leases and idempotency keys, LLM-as-judge review gates before anything goes out, and Telegram channels to steer it.

entries.name: Co-Founder & Engineer · Mrrlin, AI execution workspace
entries.descr: Designed and built: turns one goal into a plan of tasks, routes them to Claude Code, Codex CLI and other models, sends weak output back through multi-model review, runs each task in its own git worktree and closes it only with proof (live URL, green build or sign-off). In daily use by our team.
